title: Canonical single-complex comparison on a source open
statement: For a commutative square of schemes with arrows f:X→S, f':X'→S', g:S'→S, g':X'→X [def-pc-scheme], derived objects K on X and K' on X' [def-pc-derived-category], and φ:L(g')*K→K', define for each open U of X its canonical comparison. Put P=X'×_X U, p:P→X', q:P→U. Set K_U=L(U.ι)*K and K'_P=Lp*K'. The coefficient map Lq*K_U→K'_P is the composite c(q,U.ι), the equality transport q≫U.ι=p≫g', c(p,g') inverse, and Lp*(φ), where c is the canonical derived pullback composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Define b_U as the canonical base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] for U→S, P→S', g, q on K_U followed by R(P→S')* of this coefficient map [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-pullback].
